name: Matsuura Misao
source:
Nanbu's classmate. Matsuura is a blond, blue-eyed bishounen who's always smiling, looks like a chick and is rumored to be able to see spirits. His family runs a Shinto shrine and people are not quite comfortable with him because of his supposed psychic powers. He is a model student otherwise with a keen appreciation of nature, aesthetics and Japanese history.

[From [url=http://aarinfantasy.com/forum/f16/t96302-review-shuugyou-ryokou-koto.html]Aarinfantasy Forums[/url]]
